decisions.reason: The ACE3 distributed ALCMS control unit is a core part of the firm's airfield lighting business, and airports run such systems for decades, which brings ongoing upgrade and service revenue.
The air situation display fits the firm's tower and surveillance portfolio and complements the multilateration flagship, though it may later be folded into a broader suite.
Training programs cost little to maintain and support installed-base customers, so the firm has little reason to withdraw this one.
The airfield ground lighting course supports the firm's core lighting installed base, although it could be merged into the general training catalogue.
The collaboration software matches the firm's push toward collaborative decision-making, but software tools are often rebranded or absorbed into integrated platforms.
The multilateration system is a flagship product in a growing surveillance market, and the firm is likely to keep investing in it.
